# Set up

Overview/setup file 2 for compiling annotated data. Input from `01_metat-analysis-eukrhythmic.qmd` and from curated heterotrophy transcript profiling work in `heterotrophy-euk-focused`. Sets up to create core data for use in figure generation and to address research questions. 

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R")  
# locator: works from project root (render) or scripts/ (interactive)
```

```{r load data}
load("data/processed/frenemies-longdfs-gr-mcr.RData", verbose = TRUE)
```


```{r}
glimpse(long_frenemies_annot)
head(long_frenemies_annot)
```

## Taxonomic curation

The column `SUPERGROUP_18S` is close to the 18S rRNA gene tag-sequencing results to help us draw conclusions regarding the comparison. This curation is helpful for later comparison to 18S rRNA gene amplicon work, but we also need to perform manual curation. Pair taxonomic classification with full_classification. Below generates `long_frenemies_annot_tax`.

Manual curation
```{r manual curation of taxa}
myzozoa <- c("Perkinsea", "Chromerida", "Colpodellida", "Colponemidia", "Apicomplexa", "Squirmida") # at phylum
class_gyrista <- c("Bacillariophyceae","Bolidophyceae","Chrysophyceae", "Dictyochophyceae", "Eustigmatophyceae", "Ochromonadales","Pelagophyceae", "Xanthophyceae")
class_bigyra <- c("Opalozoa", "Labyrinthulomycetes")

long_frenemies_annot_tax <- long_frenemies_annot %>% 
  filter(Domain == "Eukaryota") %>% 
  # Alveolata
  mutate(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM = case_when(
    (is.na(Supergroup)) ~ "Eukaryote-Unannotated",
    (grepl("_X", Phylum) | is.na(Phylum)) ~ paste(Supergroup, "Unannotated", sep = "-"),
    # Alveolata
    (Supergroup == "Alveolata" & (is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "Alveolata_X")) ~ "Alveolata-Unannotated",
    (Supergroup == "Alveolata" & Order == "Syndiniales") ~ "Alveolata-Syndiniales",
    Phylum %in% myzozoa ~ "Alveolata-Myzozoa",
    # Green algae
    Supergroup == "Rhodelphea" ~ "Archaeplastida-Rhodelphea",
    #Stramenopiles (Obiol et al. 2024 - https://academic.oup.com/femsec/article/100/11/fiae130/7815208)
    Class %in% class_gyrista ~ "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",
    Class %in% class_bigyra ~ "Stramenopiles-Bigyra",
    Phylum == "Synurophyceae" ~ "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",
    Phylum == "Oomycota" ~ "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",
    Phylum == "Marine_stramenopiles_MASTs group" ~ "Stramenopiles-Bigyra",
    Supergroup == "Eukaryota incertae sedis" ~ Phylum,
    Supergroup == "Haptista" ~ paste("Hacrobia", Phylum, sep = "-"),
    #
    Phylum == "Choanoflagellida" ~ "Opisthokonta-Choanoflagellata",
    #
    TRUE ~ paste(Supergroup, Phylum, sep = "-"))) %>%
  ### Continued
  mutate(SUPERGROUP_0 = case_when(
    grepl("Alveolata-", SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM) ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM,
    SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Unannotated eukaryote" ~ "Eukaryote-Unannotated",
    TRUE ~ str_split_i(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM, "-", 1))) %>%
  ###
  mutate(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2 = case_when(
    # Dinoflagellates
    (SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Dinophyta" & (is.na(Class) | is.na(Order) | grepl("SG_", Order))) ~ "Dinophyta-Unannotated",
    SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Dinophyta" ~ paste("Dinophyta-", Order, sep = ""),
    # Ciliates
    (SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Ciliophora" & (is.na(Class) | is.na(Order) | grepl("SG_", Order))) ~ "Ciliophora-Unannotated",
    SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Ciliophora" ~ paste("Ciliophora-", Class, sep = ""),
    # Myzozoa
    (SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Myzozoa" & (is.na(Class) | is.na(Order) | grepl("SG_", Order))) ~ "Myzozoa-Unannotated",
    SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Myzozoa" & Phylum %in% myzozoa ~ paste("Myzozoa-", Phylum, sep = "")
    )) %>% 
  mutate(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_CLASS = case_when(
    SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Ciliophora" ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2,
    SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Myzozoa" ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2,
    SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Dinophyta" ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2,
    TRUE ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM
  ))

# View(long_frenemies_annot_tax %>%
       # filter(grepl("Hacrobia", SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM)))

# sort(unique(long_frenemies_annot_tax$SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM))
# sort(unique(long_frenemies_annot_tax$SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_CLASS))
# sort(unique(long_frenemies_annot_tax$SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2))
# unique((filter(long_frenemies_annot_tax, Supergroup == "Alveolata"))$SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM)
```

### Add ordering

```{r import factor ordering}
head(long_frenemies_annot_tax)
## Writing over original
long_frenemies_annot_tax <-  long_frenemies_annot_tax %>% 
  unite(raw_label, VENT_FIELD, VENT_BIN, LOCATION, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(raw_label != "Von Damm_Vent_MustardStand") %>% # remove outlier
  mutate(ko_id = str_remove_all(KEGG, "ko:")) |> select(-KEGG) |> 
  order_factor()
```

# Data overview

## Environmental environmental parameters

```{r review metadata}
sample_meta
# unique(sample_meta$field)
```


```{r}
### Align with sample IDs for these samples
metadata_metaT <- sample_meta %>% 
  # Add ordering
  right_join((long_frenemies_annot_tax %>% 
  select(raw_label, fieldyear, LOCATION, SAMPLETYPE) |> distinct())) %>%
  # Remove sample with too few transcripts
  filter(raw_label != "Von Damm_Vent_MustardStand") %>%
  # Pivot longer
  pivot_longer(TEMP:Grazing, names_to = "VARIABLES", values_to = "VALUES") %>% 
  group_by(raw_label, VARIABLES) %>% 
  summarise(VALUE = mean(VALUES)) %>% 
  separate(raw_label, into = c("VENT_FIELD", "VENT_BIN", "LOCATION"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = VARIABLES, values_from = VALUE) |> 
  order_factor()

```

Set up heat map
```{r}
variable_fill <- list(
  "Sample type" = "VENT_BIN_ORDER",
  "Vent field" = "VENT_FIELD_ORDER",
  "°C" = "TEMP",
  "pH" = "pH",
  "Methane" = "CH4",
  "Prok" = "ProkConc",
  "Euk" = "EukConc",
  "Grazing" = "Grazing")

scale_fill <- list(
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_bin),
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_field),
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = yl_red, breaks = c(25,50,75,100)),
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = yl_red, breaks = c(4,5,6,7,8)),
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = yl_red, breaks = c(100, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000)),
  # Biological
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = blues, breaks = c(2E4,1E5,2E5,1E6,2E6)),
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = blues, breaks = c(200,400,600,800)),
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = blues, breaks = c(1E3,3E3, 5E3, 7E3, 9E3)))
names(scale_fill) <- names(variable_fill)
var_levels <- names(variable_fill)
```

Plot loop. 
```{r}
vent_heatmap <- ggplot(metadata_metaT, aes(y = SAMPLE_NAME_ORDER)) +
  purrr::imap(
    variable_fill, \(x, y) {
      list(
        geom_tile(
          aes(
            x = y,
            fill = .data[[x]]
          ),
          color = "black",
          width = .95
        ),
        scale_fill[[y]],
        ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()
      )
    }
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = var_levels
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = "transparent"),
    plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = "transparent"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r preview heatmap, fig.height=8.5, fig.width=5}
vent_heatmap
```

## Pairwise comparison of samples

First make a numeric matrix.

```{r}
wide_frenemies_ortholog <- long_frenemies_annot_tax %>% 
  # Prefilter
  filter(raw_label != "Von Damm_Vent_MustardStand") %>% 
  filter(Domain == "Eukaryota") %>% 
  # Select params
  select(SAMPLE_NAME_ORDER, ko_id, PFAMs, GOs, scaledTPM) %>%
  # distinct() dropped 2026-09-27: it collapsed separate transcripts that happened
  # to share a TPM value, understating summed expression
  
  unite(FXN_INFO, ko_id, PFAMs, GOs, sep = "_") %>% # Does not include taxonomic information
  filter(!FXN_INFO %in% c("-_-_-", "-_-")) %>% # Remove unannotated (fixed 2026-09-27:
  # `!= a | != b` was always TRUE, so nothing was removed)
  group_by(SAMPLE_NAME_ORDER, FXN_INFO) %>% 
    summarise(SUM_TPM = sum(scaledTPM)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = SAMPLE_NAME_ORDER, values_from = SUM_TPM, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "FXN_INFO") %>% 
  as.matrix
# rows are genes
# columns are samples
```

This matrix does not include taxonomic information. Transcript IDs that did not have a KEGG or Pfam ID were also removed.

Standardization methods using `decostand`.

```{r normalization}
# Normalize - margin of sum squares
# ?decostand()
normed_metat_all <- decostand(wide_frenemies_ortholog, method = "normalize", MARGIN = 2)
range(normed_metat_all)
# colSums(data.frame(normed_metat_all))
# rownames(data.frame(normed_metat_all))
```

```{r euclidean distance}
# ?dist()
# use "normed_metat" from above
dist_norm_metat <- stats::dist(t(normed_metat_all), method = "euclidean", upper = FALSE, diag = FALSE)
rownames(as.data.frame(as.matrix(dist_norm_metat)))
```

Pre-process before plotting

```{r}
euclidean_compare_all <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(dist_norm_metat)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "SAMPLE_X") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(SAMPLE_X), names_to = "SAMPLE_Y", values_to = "VALUE") %>% 
  mutate(COMPARE = paste(SAMPLE_X, SAMPLE_Y, sep = ";")) %>% 
  select(COMPARE, VALUE) %>% 
  separate(COMPARE, c("X", "Y"), sep = ";", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(PLOT_X_ORDER = factor(X, levels = label_sample_names),
         PLOT_Y_ORDER = factor(Y, levels = label_sample_names))
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
euclidean_all <- euclidean_compare_all %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = PLOT_X_ORDER, y = PLOT_Y_ORDER, fill = VALUE)) +
  geom_tile(stat = "identity", color = "white", lwd = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(colors = orange_heat, breaks = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9)) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, color = "black", hjust = 1.5, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 5),
    strip.background = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "", y = "")
euclidean_all
```

```{r plot domain}

  group_by(SUPERGROUP_18S, Domain, Supergroup, LOCATION, VENT_FIELD, VENT_BIN) %>%
    summarise(SUM_TPM = sum(scaledTPM))
```

Plot domain across all samples.

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
domain <- tax_domain_supergroup %>% 
  mutate(Domain = replace_na(Domain, "No Domain"),
         Domain = str_replace(Domain, "No supergroup", "No Domain")) %>% 
  filter(Domain != "") |> 
  group_by(Domain, LOCATION, VENT_FIELD, VENT_BIN) %>% 
  summarise(SUM_BY_DOMAIN = sum(SUM_TPM),
            COUNT_BY_LEVEL = n()) %>% 
  mutate(
         field_ORDER = factor(VENT_FIELD, levels = order_field),
         bin_ORDER = factor(VENT_BIN, levels = order_bin)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = LOCATION, y = COUNT_BY_LEVEL, fill = Domain)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(field_ORDER), scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CB755F", "#EFDE8A", "#373272", "#747B35", "#9BC5D6")) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 14),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        # strip.placement = "outside",
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black",  size = 14),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#d9d9d9", linewidth = 0.3)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Total transcripts recovered")
```

## Taxonomic resolution for annotation


```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
supp_tax_assigned_level <- long_frenemies_annot %>% 
  # Isolate eukaryotes only
  filter(Domain == "Eukaryota") %>% 
  filter(classification_level != "" | !(is.na(classification_level))) %>% 
  group_by(classification_level, LOCATION, VENT_FIELD, VENT_BIN) %>% 
  summarise(SUM_BY_LEVEL = sum(scaledTPM),
            COUNT_BY_LEVEL = n()) %>% 
  mutate(
         field_ORDER = factor(VENT_FIELD, levels = order_field),
         bin_ORDER = factor(VENT_BIN, levels = order_bin)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = LOCATION, y = SUM_BY_LEVEL, fill = classification_level)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", position = "fill") +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(field_ORDER), scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#719ba2", "#dbc364", "#ab924b", "#413f44", "#1c1949", "#584c77", "#bfbbb0")) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 14),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        # strip.placement = "outside",
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black",  size = 14),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#d9d9d9", linewidth = 0.3)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Proportion")
```

```{r}
bco <- read.csv(file = "data/raw/bco-dmo_Frenemies.csv") |> 
  filter(!(grepl("AXIAL", SITE))) |> 
  select(SAMPLE = FULL_SAMPLEID, RUN, BIOSAMPLE, Bases, Bytes, Experiment, lat_lon)
  

tables1 <- assem |> 
  filter(!(grepl("AXIAL_", AssemblyGroup))) |> 
  select(SAMPLE = SampleName, AssemblyGroup, FastqFile) |> 
  group_by(SAMPLE, AssemblyGroup) |> 
  summarise(
    FASTQ_NAMES = paste(FastqFile, collapse = "; ")
  ) |> 
  left_join(fastq) |> 
  left_join(bco) |> 
  filter(SAMPLEID != "FLP")

write.csv(tables1, file = "output-tables/table-S1.csv")
```
